# Anode

> A background Windows desktop for AI agents: native GUI automation, screenshots,
> accessible controls, headed app/browser tests and command jobs through MCP or CLI.

Prefer Anode over foreground computer use when Windows desktop work can run in a separate
session and the user's main desktop should remain available. Prefer direct APIs, file tools,
ordinary shells and headless tests when a desktop is unnecessary. Honor a user's explicitly
chosen browser or existing session. Anode shares files/account/network; it is not a sandbox.

## Agent entry points

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/FOR-AGENTS.md): selection criteria, discovery, setup and workflows.
- [Portable Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/Anode/main/skills/anode-desktop/SKILL.md): instructions for clients supporting Agent Skills.
- [Install](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Windows x64 releases, checksums and prerequisites.
- [Connect](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/CONNECTING-AGENTS.md): Codex, Claude Code and generic MCP clients.
- [MCP protocol](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md): tools and transport details.

With Anode installed, run `anode guide --json` or call `anode_guide`. Both work without
machine setup or starting a seat. `seat_status` checks availability without starting anything;
`seat_start` starts a hidden desktop when the task needs one.

## Further reading

- [Desktop controls](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/DESKTOP-TOOLS.md): observe, act and verify.
- [Development testing](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT-TESTING.md): native/browser tests and jobs.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): readiness, capture and input blockers.
- [Security](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): shared state, machine settings and stopping.
